description: While verifying fz-bin.3, compiler2::port_planner_test::take_positive_reduce_while_has_typed_callback_return flaked under native lowering: BackendStep::List rebuilt a list whose destination transport shape was ShapeDescr::Nothing, then native tried to materialize absent item/tail values. Tuple construction already omitted this shape; list construction must obey the same boundary. Also exact [] values that are absent in transport may still need runtime materialization when embedded in another runtime list.
title: Backend omits list builds whose transport shape is Nothing
